variables.name: AIRI Controlled Player
variables.description: The exact in-game name of the already-connected player AIRI is allowed to control. AI control stays disabled until this is set.

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible model name used for AIRI's responses.

variables.name: Provider Base URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Change this to point at a different provider/proxy.

variables.name: Save File Name
variables.description: Which save under /saves to boot. Leave blank to auto-detect (only works if exactly one save exists) or to create a new one on first boot.

variables.name: Auto Update AIRI Release
variables.description: Whether the supervisor is allowed to install newer AIRI releases automatically. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

variables.name: Watch For Updates
variables.description: Whether the supervisor periodically checks for newer AIRI releases in the background. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

variables.name: Update Check Interval (Minutes)
variables.description: How often (in minutes) the supervisor checks for a newer AIRI release.

variables.name: Max AI Requests Per Hour
variables.description: Hourly cap on LLM provider calls, to bound API spend.

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout (ms)
variables.description: How long a graceful stop waits for Factorio to save and exit before forcing termination.

variables.name: Extra Factorio Arguments
variables.description: JSON array of additional CLI flags passed to the Factorio binary. Flags that would override managed settings (port, save, config, mod directory, etc.) are rejected.
